newsitem.title: USA: Lam Research names Newberry COO.
newsitem.headline: Lam Research names Newberry COO.

text.p: Lam Research Corp said ti named Stephen Newberry executive vice president and chief operating officer.
Before joining Lam, Newberry served as group vice president of global operations and planning for Applied Materials Inc.
As executive vice president and COO, Newberry will join Lam president Way Tu in the office of the president, reporting to James Bagley, chief executive officer.
Newberry replaces Robert Fink, chief operating officer, who previously announced his plans to retire at the end of the year.
